notes.title: Gravitee v1.0.7 - restart button on pause menu & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Another small update for Gravitee.

There's now a restart button when you pause the game:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635957/7c3899114f9ee70e1bb8685d23eba26d47e8364e.png"]

A few bugs have been fixed:
- A bug where you could get softlocked on level 13 is fixed.
- When you are using a second monitor, the cursor no longer leaves the game, stopping you from rotating.
- A bug with the "information opens automatically" setting not getting saved is fixed.

Thanks for your bug reports & support so far!

sightafter

notes.title: Gravitee v1.0.5 - in-game achievement tracker, invert mouse setting & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Here's a small update for Gravitee.

There's now an in-game tracker for achievements! When you hit pause, you'll be able to see a relevant achievement, and your current progress towards it in the level.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635957/9fd05f06f29eb707fa96bfcfd99cfd5d9e470910.png"]
There's also an invert mouse option in the settings now.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635957/a70725baf6aa006cd3b4af7c7f0d279e44e9d0e8.png"]

This version also fixed a bug where the achievement "Controlled Demolition" wouldn't work.



Have fun!

sightafter
